name: Thanasis's mother
description: An independent artisan who died three months before Pavios arrived, apparently taken by a beast.

timeline.summary: Thanasis shares the story of his mother's death, and Pavios embraces and kisses his cheek, but Thanasis stiffens.
timeline.quote: Pavios pulled him close, embracing him, and kissed his cheek.
